name: Stanley Reagan
fact: Reagan sat on the Interhall Council in 1985-86, the year after he chaired the Associated Student Government Rules and Elections Committee. He was a public relations major from Tompkinsville and graduated in 1986.

src.label: 1986 Talisman, p. 196, Interhall Council group photograph and caption, and p. 314, senior class portraits

name: Jon LeTendre
fact: LeTendre was a Sigma Chi, photographed in the fraternity front row in the 1986 Talisman, and sat in the College Republicans the following year.

src.label: 1986 Talisman, p. 269, Sigma Chi group photograph; 1987 Talisman, p. 120, College Republicans
